newsitem.title: USA: IPO AVTEAM refiles with new underwriter.
newsitem.headline: IPO AVTEAM refiles with new underwriter.

text.p: A planned initial public offering in AVTEAM Inc refiled with new lead underwriter CS First Boston, a spokesman said on Tuesday.

The deal, initially handled by lead underwriters Dillon Read & Co and Alex Brown & Sons Inc, was later under lead underwriter Credit Suisse First Boston. It currently is being handled by CS First Boston for an expected trading date in mid-May.
The company has proposed to offer 4.5 million class A shares at an estmaited price range at between $10 to $12 per share under the proposed symbol "AVTM" on the Nasdaq National Market for mid-May.
In related news, a planned initial public offering in International Business Systems was postponed due to market conditions, according to lead underwriter CS First Boston.
The Swedish company proposed to offer 6.6 million ADS -- each ADS consisted of an ordinary share -- for this week under the symbol was "IBSDY" on the Nasdaq National Market.
